input.content: scripts/export.py produces the monthly invoice report that Finance imports into their accounting tool at the start of each month. It runs from the ops cron on the 2nd at 06:00 UTC and writes one file per environment to EXPORT_BUCKET under `exports/<YYYY-MM>/invoices.csv`. Finance reconciles the totals against the ledger, so every finalized invoice of the month must appear exactly once, including zero-amount ones; drafts are excluded. Columns, in order: invoice id, customer id, subtotal, tax, total, finalized date. Amounts are integer cents with no currency symbol. Format requirements (Finance moved to a new accounting tool in late Sept/Oct 2026; the old German-locale tool wanted `;` and `DD.MM.YYYY`, no longer applies): plain comma-separated (`,`) and ISO dates `YYYY-MM-DD` (strftime `%Y-%m-%d`).
